name: calc_wacc
description:
Weighted average cost of capital: E/V * cost of equity + D/V * cost of debt * (1 - tax rate). Computed locally in Python; no API key or network.
Returns {wacc, equity_weight, debt_weight}: wacc in percent (4 decimals), weights as fractions.
Inputs (* required): equity_value*, debt_value* (same currency, usually market values), cost_of_equity* (percent), cost_of_debt* (pre-tax percent), tax_rate* (percent).
For the cost of equity use calc_capm; use the result as the wacc of calc_dcf_model.
Example: {"equity_value": 800, "debt_value": 200, "cost_of_equity": 10, "cost_of_debt": 5, "tax_rate": 25}

debt_value.description: Value of debt, same currency as equity_value
